commands.name: tls-sanitizer-compilation
command:
import hashlib, json, shlex
from pathlib import Path
rows = []
for build in (Path('/work/build-05a-final/server-asan-ubsan'),
              Path('/work/build-05a-final-client/linux-asan-ubsan')):
    path = build / 'compile_commands.json'
    entries = json.loads(path.read_text())
    c_units = [entry for entry in entries if Path(entry['file']).suffix == '.c']
    assert len(c_units) == 116, f'Unexpected TLS C compiler units: {build}'
    for entry in c_units:
        assert '/_deps/mbedtls-src/' in entry['file'], entry['file']
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    required = {
        'engine/core/src/net_interest.cpp', 'tests/net_interest_tests.cpp',
        'tests/net_interest_probe.cpp', 'engine/core/src/net_replication.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_replication_wire.cpp', 'tests/core_net_replication_tests.cpp',
        'tests/core_net_replication_wire_tests.cpp', 'tests/replication_probe.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_transport.cpp', 'engine/core/src/net_session.cpp',
        'engine/core/src/net_session_wire.cpp', 'tests/core_net_mtls_tests.cpp',
        'tests/core_net_session_tests.cpp', 'tests/session_probe.cpp',
    }
    required.update(json.loads('["tests/net_adversity_tests.cpp", "tests/net_adversity_probe.cpp"]'))
    required.update(json.loads('[]'))
    if 'client' in str(build):
        required.update({'engine_tools/src/source_document.cpp', 'tests/source_document_tests.cpp'})
        required.update(json.loads('["engine_tools/src/authored_scene.cpp", "tests/authored_scene_tests.cpp"]'))
    for entry in entries:
        is_tools = '/engine_tools/' in entry['file']
        assert ('json-src' in entry['command']) == is_tools, entry['file']
        if is_tools:
            assert '-isystem' in entry['command'] and 'JSON_USE_IMPLICIT_CONVERSIONS=0' in entry['command']
    owned = [entry for entry in entries
             if any(entry['file'].endswith('/' + name) for name in required)]
    assert len(owned) == len(required), f'Missing instrumented network units: {build}'
    for entry in owned:
        arguments = entry.get('arguments') or shlex.split(entry['command'])
        assert Path(arguments[0]).name == 'clang++-18', arguments[0]
        assert '-fsanitize=address,undefined' in arguments, entry['file']
        assert '-fno-omit-frame-pointer' in arguments, entry['file']
    rows.append({'build': str(build), 'status': 'PASS',
                 'tls_c_translation_units': len(c_units),
                 'owned_network_and_source_translation_units': len(owned),
                 'owned_network_sources': sorted(required),
                 'compiler': 'clang-18', 'sanitizers': ['address', 'undefined'],
                 'compile_commands_sha256': hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
print(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))
